set.body:
Build the source identity graph once per film from video, ASR/captions and optional annotations,
before and without any recall text. An LLM proposes identity edges (proposal-only, rule 13); the
deterministic resolver accepts each by its S2 licence class. Unresolved identities keep their
alternatives. Captions derived from the same footage are not independent corroboration.

Before trusting visual edges, measure the error rate of the sampled-pair visual association on
the body rows (known: same body called different people, orientation flips). If too high, add a
track-level continuity source and record its admission.

Acceptance: graph reproducible with receipts; identity precision reported per basis class; the
d507/d575 depicted-described link is either licensed with cited basis or Open with candidates.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3] Recall-blind per-film source identity graph with licensed edges
